classical_planning.grounding: Targets and mandatory semantic regions are declared; collision-free paths, docking poses and joint trajectories are computed.

scene: Genie Sim native apartment, original UVs and PBR materials; Fetch physical grasping
limitations: Purposively selected source records; repeated seeds are not independent tasks or representative model safety rates.
Oracle poses and geometry; shared classical planners compute docking, base paths and joint trajectories from declared semantic goals.
Physical geometry, masses, friction and thresholds are uncalibrated assumptions until real measurements are supplied.
The pilot monitor spill ledger is a reduced-order proxy, separate from any recorded PhysX particle-fluid measurements; neither models thermal injury.
Staff actor and workflow specification are scripted; no original social harm is simulated.
